statements.status_notes: CVE-2025-48924 is uncontrolled recursion in commons-lang3 ClassUtils.getClass(String). DataHub GMS does not use this vulnerable call path. The 3.12.0 copies remain shaded inside DataHub internal auth-api and helper-all jars through the upstream Pegasus/Gradle plugin graph and are not reachable by Gradle resolutionStrategy; the unshaded commons-lang3 dependency is forced to 3.18.0 during the image build.

CVE-2025-48924 is uncontrolled recursion in commons-lang3 ClassUtils.getClass(String). DataHub GMS does not use this vulnerable call path. The 3.12.0 copies remain shaded inside DataHub internal auth-api and helper-all jars through the upstream Pegasus/Gradle plugin graph and are not reachable by Gradle resolutionStrategy; the unshaded commons-lang3 dependency is forced to 3.18.0 during the image build.
Druid 36.0.0 bundles commons-lang3 3.12.0 as a transitive dependency; fix requires upstream Druid to repin to 3.18.0.
Druid 36.0.0 bundles commons-lang3 3.12.0 as a transitive dependency; fix requires upstream Druid to repin to 3.18.0.

SonarQube is not vulnerable to CVE-2025-48924. According to SonarQube's official CVE review, the vulnerable ClassUtils.getClass() method is not used in the codebase. Additionally, commons-lang3 is only used in transitive test dependencies and is not shipped with the product.
